name: Sierra Metals
old_description: At Sierra Metals Southwest LLC, we specialize in crafting exceptional architectural and ornamental metals in the Las Vegas area. With a passion for precision and design, we offer both standard and custom solutions to elevate commercial, residential, or artistic spaces. From intricate details to bold elements our expert team delivers high quality metal work tailored to your vision.
about:
Sierra Metals Southwest LLC operates from a facility at 3555 West Oquendo Road in Las Vegas, Nevada. The company does not publish a founding date, but its ownership group brings more than 40 years of metal‑fabrication experience to the business. Sierra Metals is part of a family of companies that includes Andy Russo Jr Inc, a union installation specialist, and Magnus Ornamental Metals, which focuses on ornamental and residential metalwork.

The shop provides architectural and ornamental metal fabrication using a range of processes: MIG welding of steel, TIG welding of stainless steel, brass and aluminum; shearing up to 3/16‑inch mild steel in 12‑foot lengths; ACM routing; polishing to #4, #6 and #8 finishes; light‑gauge bending up to 16 gauge in 12‑foot lengths; CAD design support; water‑jet cutting; and plasma cutting. From these capabilities it produces both standard and custom items such as fences, gates, decorative handrails and ceilings, door frames and guards, shade panels, louvers, trellises, security screens, art sculptures, ACM panels, metal soffit, fascia, trim, wall panels and standing‑seam roofing panels.

Sierra Metals serves commercial, residential and artistic clients in the Las Vegas region. Its customer base includes architects, general contractors, homeowners and artists. A noted collaboration is with F&A Modular Homes, for which Sierra Metals designs and fabricates metal components for modular housing units. The sister firms extend the offering to union‑grade installation and residential ornamental work.

The company states that its differentiation rests on four values: craftsmanship that blends skill with artistry, innovation that pushes custom solutions, customer focus that builds lasting relationships, and reliability that honors promises with timely service. This philosophy, coupled with the ownership’s deep industry tenure, is presented as the reason clients choose Sierra Metals for metalwork that is both functional and expressive.
